source: Certified copy from MKR Gračišće 1841–1899, folio 108, entry 23, issued by the Državni arhiv u Pazinu to David Defranceski, 26 April 2021 (KLASA 053-02/21-02/195), signed by the director Mirela Mrak.
record: the register says «n. heri» — born yesterday
his condition is given as «lapidarius» — a stonemason
surname not confidently read from this reproduction
a marginal note added in 1951 by the civil registry office
the kind of note that records a later marriage or death
why: This is the record the Pazin archive was asked for by name, and it is the one that anchors the family in Gračišće rather than Gologorica.
The father's condition matters. «Lapidarius» — stonemason. Not the «Dominus» of the Gologorica gentry two villages away, and not a landholder: a man who cut stone.
A Defranceschi household was still counted at Gračišće in the census of 1 October 1945, eighty-two years after this baptism.
And the 1951 marginal note means the civil registry came back to this page in the Yugoslav period — so the same person is traceable forward into records this archive has not yet opened.
